Pressure Switches
 All types
 All Manufacturers

This 
 document outlines 
 the checklist I1 for 
 all types of pressure switches, which must be 
 performed every year as 
 indicated 
 by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid Ali revised by eng Abdalla 
 Mohamed Ahmed, accepted by eng. Adel Abdelkader Elnagar approved by eng. 
 Elsherbiny Ismail Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved by eng 
 Ibrahim Hassan head sector of new Talkha power station (750 M.W)

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdelgilil MDEPC quality control general 
 manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb instruction 
 quality control's head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.

Close manual valve 
 for indicator line

Ohmmeter or multimeter (Fluke - 180 
 series digital multimeter)

Review technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of switch setting values record it in 
 its MPRDS.

Connect pressure 
 calibrator to pressure switch

Inject the suitable pressure value reference to 
 setting and record at MRDS, using ohmmeter, check contact if change in its 
 situation.

If there is any error, using screw driver adjust 
 the switch and repeat step 1.

Return the switch to service by removing the 
 pressure tester from the switch vent.
Open manual valve for switch line.

Place a copy of test result in the field 
 maintenance file.

Introduction
This 
 document outlines 
 the checklist I1 for 
 all types of pressure switches, which must be 
 performed every year as 
 indicated 
 by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid Ali revised by eng Abdalla 
 Mohamed Ahmed, accepted by eng. Adel Abdelkader Elnagar approved by eng. 
 Elsherbiny Ismail Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved by eng 
 Ibrahim Hassan head sector of new Talkha power station (750 M.W)
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdelgilil MDEPC quality control general 
 manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb instruction 
 quality control's head sector
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes.
Close manual valve 
 for indicator line
Tools and Equipments
Pressure tester (druck - dpi 610)
Ohmmeter or multimeter (Fluke - 180 
 series digital multimeter)
Safety driver
Set of key
Work to be carried out
Steps to prepare 
for test
Review technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of switch setting values record it in 
 its MPRDS.
Connect pressure 
 calibrator to pressure switch
Adjust open and close value
Calibrating 
procedure
Inject the suitable pressure value reference to 
 setting and record at MRDS, using ohmmeter, check contact if change in its 
 situation.
If there is any error, using screw driver adjust 
 the switch and repeat step 1.
Return pressure 
switch to Service
Return the switch to service by removing the 
 pressure tester from the switch vent.
Close indicator vent.
Open manual valve for switch line.
Place a copy of test result in the field 
 maintenance file.
